name: Game Dev DrinkUp Edinburgh
description:
A meetup for game developers in the Edinburgh area, on the 2nd Thursday of every month.

The Game Dev Drink Up is a monthly international game developer social meetup event, spanning locations from LA, Seattle, New York and Montreal to Tokyo and Manila, and now Edinburgh.
short_description: Monthly social for Edinburgh-area game developers — part of the international Game Dev Drink Up series, at The Holyrood 9A.
